info.title: Fidel API
info.description: Accessible learning media for Ethiopian learning platforms. Read endpoints are public. Write endpoints need the staff token: `Authorization: Bearer <FIDEL_STAFF_TOKEN>`.

post.description: Upload a lesson video. Processing starts in the background; follow it at status_url.

get.description: Published lessons. Staff (with the token) also see unpublished ones.

schema.title: Response List Lessons Api V1 Lessons Get

get.description:
Everything a player needs: file URLs and caption statuses.
Unpublished lessons are only shown to staff.

delete.description: Delete a lesson and all its files. This cannot be undone.

schema.title: Response Get Status Api V1 Lessons  Lesson Id  Status Get

put.description:
Save corrected captions. The file becomes 'reviewed' only when every
cue is marked reviewed; otherwise it stays 'draft'.

post.description: Run some pipeline steps again (e.g. after downloading a model).

schema.title: Response Rebuild Api V1 Lessons  Lesson Id  Rebuild Post

get.description: Caption cues with their review state, for the Studio editor.

post.description:
Upload a caption file (for lessons that already have captions, or when
the speech-to-text model is not installed). It replaces this language's
captions and is marked draft until a person checks it in Studio.

put.description:
Save chapters. The Amharic chapter file is written only when every
chapter has an Amharic title (no half-English 'Amharic' file).

Save audio description text: what is shown on screen and not said aloud.

If the optional voice engine is set up for this language (Amharic, Afaan
Oromo), every description without a person's recording gets a machine-read
recording automatically, in the background: like English, which the
browser reads aloud. Never replaces a person's recording.

post.description:
Attach a recording to one description. Needed for Amharic: most phones
have no Amharic voice to read description text aloud.

Make (or make again) a MACHINE-READ recording of one description with
the optional voice engine (Amharic, Afaan Oromo). Saving descriptions does
this automatically; this is for one description, e.g. after the engine was
started. Replaces any recording. 409 if no voice engine is set up.

Upload the Ethiopian Sign Language video. It must start at the same
moment as the lesson video. It is resized for the sign window in the background.
Make the lesson visible to learners (or hide it again).

get.description: Returns ok if the staff token is right (401 if not).

schema.title: Response Check Token Api V1 Staff Check Get

get.description:
The whole lesson in ONE web page (audio, transcripts, font inside).
Save it on a phone and open it with no internet.

parameters.name: inline

schema.description: Show in the browser instead of downloading
schema.title: Inline

parameters.description: Show in the browser instead of downloading

get.description:
Offline pack (.zip): the one-page lesson plus caption, description and
plain-text transcript files.

The lesson as an accessible document: chapters as headings, transcript,
audio descriptions, and slide images with descriptions written by staff.
The same document as a tagged PDF (PDF/UA-1) with Ethiopic font embedded.

The lesson's title, chapters and transcript as a Braille Ready File
(.brf: Unified English Braille grade 2, 40 cells by 25 lines), for
embossers and refreshable Braille displays.
The transcript as plain text (UTF-8), one caption per line.

post.description:
Add a job. Returns it as schema.org/JobPosting JSON-LD. With the optional
voice engine, the Amharic summary gets a machine-read recording in the
background (no recording by a person yet).

get.description: Open jobs (closing date today or later), newest first.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api V1 Jobs Get

post.description:
A recording of the summary being read aloud (needed for Amharic:
most phones have no Amharic voice).

Make a MACHINE-READ recording of the summary with the optional voice
engine (Amharic only), when no person has recorded it. The job card says
it is machine-read. 409 if no voice engine is set up.
Issue a certificate. Share its verify_url with the learner.

schema.title: Response List Certificates Api V1 Certificates Get

post.description: Register an address. Keep the returned secret: it is not shown again.

schema.title: Response List Webhooks Api V1 Webhooks Get

post.description:
A learner reports a caption problem. No name or account is needed or
stored. 400 with a message in words if something is not right; 429 after
20 reports from one address in an hour.

get.description: Reports for one lesson, in video-time order (staff).

schema.title: Response List Caption Reports Api V1 Lessons  Lesson Id  Caption Reports Get

patch.description: Mark a report resolved (the caption was fixed) or dismissed (nothing to fix), or open again (staff).

get.description: Simple liveness check used by Docker and by tests.
